$comment: FAKE-CONNECTION-ENFORCES-NOTHING-01 — أساس مُعلَن يمنع النموّ ولا يدّعي أنّ ما فيه سليم. `claiming_db_enforced` مسحٌ خام مُشتقّ من النصّ، والخروج منه يكون بإثبات الملفّ على قاعدة حيّة لا بحذف الكلمة من نصّه — ويُعلَن السداد في `proven_live` (لا يُشتقّ: الإثبات الحيّ لا يغيّر النصّ). الدَّين القائم = الأوّل ناقص الثاني، وهو المُراقَب. `fake_connection_tests` يُكشَف بنيويّاً (صنفُ البديل لا اسمه)، ولا ينمو إلّا بقيدٍ في `admissions` يُسمّي مواقعه ويُبرّرها — وهو لا يُشتقّ: `--generate` يحمله ولا يكتبه، فإعادةُ التوليد لا تقبل ديناً.

services/sahool-platform/tests/test_pers.evidence: FK: أمرٌ قائم يمرّ وأمرٌ غير موجود يُرفَض بـ23503 على events.command_id. UNIQUE: الرباعيّ (tenant, field, season, ledger_digest) قبولاً بـDO NOTHING ورفضاً بـ23505 بدونه؛ وبصمةٌ غير سداسيّة تُرفَض بـ23514. زرعُ إسقاط القيد وإسقاط FK أسقط الاختبارات المعنيّة.

services/sahool-platform/tests/test_pres.evidence: UNIQUE: ON CONFLICT (prescription_id) DO NOTHING — الثاني لا يكتب والأوّل يبقى؛ زرعُ إسقاط PK أسقطه. jsonb: zones يُستعلَم بنيويّاً (array/number/12.5) ونصٌّ غير صالح يُرفَض بـ22P02؛ زرعُ تحويل العمود إلى text أسقط القبول.

services/soil-service/test_soil_projecti.evidence: UNIQUE: الفهرس جزئيّ (uq_soil_projection_active_field)، فالقبول بالمُسنِد والرفض بدونه 42P10 — وهو ما يربط تأكيدَي الوهميّ المنفصلين. وزرعُ جعل الفهرس كاملاً أسقط الرفضَ واختبارَ أنّ المكتمِل لا يحجب عملاً جديداً، فالجزئيّة نفسها مقيسة لا مفترَضة.

tests_v9/test_canonical_event_emission_c.evidence: CHECK: mobile تمرّ وbogus تُرفَض بـ23514 على events.source. TRIGGER: UPDATE وDELETE كلاهما يُرفَض بـ23514 من trg_append_only_events. jsonb: نصٌّ غير صالح يُرفَض بـ22P02، وسلوك asyncpg (jsonb نصّاً بلا مُرمِّج، مفكوكاً بعد set_type_codec) مقيس باتّصال حقيقيّ لا مفترَض.

tests_v9/test_offline_pending_queue.py.evidence: UNIQUE: ON CONFLICT (op_id) DO NOTHING — القيمة الأولى تبقى؛ وهدفٌ بلا قيد فريد (op_kind) يُرفَض بـ42P10؛ وحالةٌ خارج المجال تُرفَض بـ23514. زرعُ إسقاط PK وإسقاط CHECK أسقط كلاًّ منها.

tests_v9/test_scouting_pins_persistence..evidence: UNIQUE: ON CONFLICT (pin_id) DO NOTHING مقيس قبولاً (صفٌّ واحد، الأوّل يبقى) ورفضاً (هدف field_id ⇒ 42P10). زرعُ إسقاط scouting_pins_pkey أسقط القبول.

tests_v9/test_water_ledger.py.evidence: UNIQUE: upsert مُتماثِل على (field_id, ledger_date) ⇒ 1/9.5؛ وهدفٌ خاطئ ⇒ 42P10؛ وهويّة القيد من الكتالوج لا من الهجرة. ومعها عزلُ RLS تحت دورٍ مُثبَت NOSUPERUSER/NOBYPASSRLS، والكتابة باسم مستأجِر آخر تُرفَض بـ42501. أربعة زرعات أسقطت هذه المجموعة.

tests_v9/test_workflow_store_hardening.p.evidence: TRIGGER: updated_at مُسنَدة صراحةً إلى 2001-01-01 يدهسها المشغّل — فالبقاء والتغيّر يفترقان، والقياس عن المشغّل لا عن DEFAULT now(). والتسجيل BEFORE UPDATE FOR EACH ROW مقروء من pg_trigger. زرعُ الإسقاط وزرعُ تحويله إلى AFTER أسقطا الاثنين.

admissions.rule: نمطٌ نصّيّ على اصطلاح التسمية: class _?Fake…(Conn|Pool) · fake_conn… · fake_pool…
admissions.justification: المسحُ الأوّل لـFAKE-CONNECTION-ENFORCES-NOTHING-01 بعد أن سقطت الرحلة القانونيّة أربع مرّات على PG16 حيّة: دَينٌ قائمٌ يومَ قِيس، أُعلِن ليُمنَع نموُّه لا لأنّه سليم.

admissions.rule: measurement correction (class not name): كشفٌ بنيويّ بـAST — صنفُ اتّصال/مسبح، ترقيعُ مُورِّد الاتّصال، محاكاةٌ مُهيَّأة (`_stand_in_evidence`)
admissions.justification: measurement correction (class not name), 2026-10-15, 40 → 98. هذه المواقع دَينٌ **قائمٌ كان غيرَ مرئيّ** لا دَينٌ جديد: كلُّها على main@5472740e قبل تغيير القاعدة، وأعماها اصطلاحُ التسمية (`_Conn` · `Connection` · `fake_tenant_connection` · `_Pool`). لم يُعَد تسميةُ أيٍّ منها ولم يُعدَّل؛ الماسحُ وحده تغيّر.

Explicit one-file admission for recording parameters emitted by the real U07 writer. This test checks SQL binding and tenant GUC calls only; it does not claim native database enforcement. Separate PostgreSQL 18.6 PGlite WASM evidence exercises constraints and RLS, and remains distinct from native PG16 acceptance. No proven_live exemption is added.

Explicit three-file admission for application boundaries: decision review tests capture tenant transaction ordering, JSONB string decoding and scoped query arguments; platform tests capture canonical-source binding, SQL parameters, rollback propagation and retry identity; raster tests execute version/NULL predicates in SQLite while mocking the worker driver and processing boundary. These doubles do not enforce PostgreSQL RLS, UNIQUE, triggers or production persistence. Separate PGlite PostgreSQL 18.6 WASM evidence exercises the exact decision queue transaction under a non-bypass role, but is not native/live PostgreSQL acceptance and adds no proven_live exemption. Native PostgreSQL tests remain explicitly skipped where DATABASE_URL is absent.

Explicit two-file admission for application contracts only: provenance tests record persistence arguments and feed actual adapters with deterministic driver responses; inventory tests check read-only transaction arguments, tenant predicates, role and policy refusal, bounded reads and redaction. These doubles do not prove PostgreSQL parsing, RLS enforcement, committed persistence, or production inventory completeness. All nine remaining allocation gaps stay open; no proven_live exemption or database-enforcement claim is added. Native restricted-role SQL acceptance is still required before operation.

One explicit fault-injection site for the SQLite WAL startup race observed in CI job 117775774224. BusyOnce subclasses a real sqlite3.Connection and injects SQLITE_BUSY at the first WAL pragma to measure fresh-connection retry, connection cleanup and deadline exhaustion deterministically. Separate connections exercise a real SQLite file concurrently. This injection does not establish the real lock frequency, PostgreSQL enforcement or Railway persistence; the unchanged two-worker container command and its strict missing-module mutation remain independent CI witnesses. No proven_live exemption is added.

One explicit admission for the create_pool audit. FakePool stands in for asyncpg.create_pool to interleave concurrent cold callers deterministically and to make close() hang, which measures only the lock ordering, the bounded close and the terminate fallback in decision-service persistence, the vegetation PostgresAnomalyStore and the platform _close_db_pool. It claims no PostgreSQL enforcement: tests_v9/test_pool_single_owner_live_pg.py counts real backends in pg_stat_activity by application_name for the same three owners. No proven_live exemption is added.

Four admissions from the 2026-10-26 AI review fixes, each a fake connection that answers only the rows the code under test reads, to pin a refusal path before any database work: the decision-service receipt gate (verified_success refused unless the receipt is accepted) and the promotion guardrail direction (signed deltas, non-negative thresholds) read one decision/receipt row through _FakeConn; the platform edge/segmentation proxy test answers the tenant field-ownership fetchval to show a foreign field_id is refused before the service token is attached; the MCP market/sentinel test answers procurement fetchval calls to show the server-side approval ceiling and the token tenant are used. None claims PostgreSQL enforcement (RLS, constraints or locks); no proven_live exemption is added.

PATCH /api/v1/tasks/{id} now honours Idempotency-Key. The test needs the update to run against something that records how many times the UPDATE ran and returns the updated row, so the replay can be shown to run it once; a fake connection that answers only that one fetchrow pins the idempotency path without a database. The command store is an in-memory stand-in for the same reason. The lab-sample test in the same change uses the file's existing admitted harness.

HTTP boundary tests for append-only task irrigation observations use a SQL double to measure tenant/field predicates, immutable retry identity, worker/viewer permissions and absence of task or ledger mutations. They explicitly do not establish PostgreSQL RLS, locking, constraints or concurrent recovery. No proven_live exemption is added; live PostgreSQL acceptance remains required before rollout.

Regression witnesses from the 2026-10-27 audit fix branches (thumbs-acq-provenance 3fbf70237, rs-platform-geometry 55a4cf993, season-season-provenance 8404b1b7b). Each uses a SQL double to measure what the code sends or reads: the same-scene day representative and UTC day in the raster date accumulator; net area with holes and CRS conservation on field merge/split; asset identity carried into season NDVI rows. They do NOT establish PostgreSQL RLS, constraints, locking or concurrent recovery. No proven_live exemption is added; live PostgreSQL acceptance remains required before rollout.

Arrived with the integration head 7e3d72565 (branch ui-mobile-irrigation, UI-M1/UI-M2) without an admission, so the ratchet failed on that head before any D4/D5 change. The fake answers only the valve lookup, the tenant field check and the schedule insert, so the field derivation, the 422 conflict and the replay of the first result can be pinned without a database. It claims no PostgreSQL enforcement. The same behaviours are proven against PostgreSQL 16 under the restricted role in tests_v9/test_d4d5_idempotency_irrigation_live_pg.py, which the Live PG Proofs job runs.

D4/D5 unit contract. The irrigation, field-create and season-create routes run against fakes that answer only the rows each route reads: the valve and field lookups honour a tenant parameter when the query passes one, and otherwise act like a role that bypasses RLS. This pins the 409 reason bodies, the operation-type binding, retention, the canonical digest and the foreign-valve 404 without a database. The command store is an in-memory stand-in. No PostgreSQL enforcement is claimed here: concurrency, rollback, retention and R14/R15 are proven live in tests_v9/test_d4d5_idempotency_irrigation_live_pg.py.

Explicit one-file admission for unit contracts exercising the real field-state projection and irrigation-recommendation consumers with the existing canonical spectral resolver. The connection double supplies fixed field, season and water-ledger rows and records no live database evidence; weather and raster transports are also controlled fixtures. These tests establish propagation of declared per-index quality, acquisition dates, freshness policy and evidence identifiers, including rejection of stale, future and unknown-quality spectral evidence. They do not establish live PostgreSQL behavior, RLS, tenant authorization enforcement, SQL constraints, transactions, concurrency or production readiness. No proven_live exemption is added; any such database or operational claim requires separate live evidence.

Explicit one-file admission for the actuator safety-audit unit contract (A1-A7). It covers the 2026-11-01 audit findings in actuator_runtime and routers/commands: the rule lookup scoped by tenant, sensor and field; the device lookup under the tenant GUC; the inverse-command vocabulary for compensation; the firmware-facing issued_at made distinct per command; and kill-switch and dispatch identity. The _Conn/_DB/_P doubles return fixed rule and device rows. They imitate tenant filtering only so that the code under test sees a realistic row shape, and their transaction() is a no-op context manager. No PostgreSQL enforcement is claimed: RLS, the transaction-scoped set_config, SQL constraints and concurrency are not established here. Tenant isolation on a real database is proven separately in tests_v9/test_rls_tenant_isolation_live_pg.py. No proven_live exemption is added.

Explicit one-file admission for the v238 command-delivery unit contract (GATE-01 batch 3). The _Conn/_Pool doubles hold device_commands_log rows in a dict and imitate tenant filtering and the v238 transition trigger only so that command_delivery.py and the HTTP handlers see realistic rows; _NoDB proves the handlers refuse without a pool. No PostgreSQL enforcement is claimed here: RLS, FORCE, the BEFORE UPDATE trigger and the CHECK on delivery_state are measured on a real database in tests_v9/test_v238_actuator_delivery_state_live_pg.py. No proven_live exemption is added.

Explicit one-file admission for the v239 edge-sync wiring test (GATE-01 batch 3). The _Conn double and the patched tenant_connection record the statements edge_sync_receive issues, to show that the provenance row is written on the same transaction connection after the result insert, and that a malformed provenance block is refused with 422 before any connection opens. No database enforcement is claimed: tenant RLS+FORCE, append-only behaviour and constraints of detection_provenance are measured live in tests_v9/test_v239_detection_provenance_live_pg.py. No proven_live exemption is added.

Explicit one-file admission for the S5 revocation unit contract in the actuator (ACTUATOR-SERVICE-IGNORES-JWT-REVOCATION-01). _PoolThatMustNotBeReached fails the test if a revoked or unverifiable token ever reaches the device lookup, which is the ordering this file asserts; the inner _Conn/_Pool return one fixed device row for the allowed path. The word CHECK in the raw scan refers to the revocation check, not a SQL constraint. No PostgreSQL enforcement is claimed and device ownership on a real database is not measured here; the revocation keys are checked against a real Redis by tests_v9/test_jwt_revocation_same_redis.py. No proven_live exemption is added.

P0 wave from the 15-agent source review of main 8216ef41d. Each stand-in pins application logic that runs before or after the database, not a database-enforced property: plan binding and expiry refusals in decision-service create/authorize/claim (the refusals return before any INSERT); the activity input-ledger SQL text and the future performed_on refusal; the kill-switch safe-direction helper's behaviour under an engaged switch and under a raising connection; the weather/imagery register endpoints writing through tenant_connection and never through the BYPASSRLS jobs pool (the jobs pool stand-in raises if acquired); text-jsonb decoding in the irrigation closed-loop replay paths (asyncpg returns jsonb as str without a codec — the stand-in returns a JSON string precisely to reproduce that); and the learning worker reading season_id from the outbox envelope. The UNIQUE and jsonb words are claims about the application's handling (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING without overwrite; decoding a str payload), not proofs of PostgreSQL enforcement; no proven_live exemption is added.

Wave 2 decision-provenance hardening. The only stand-in patches persistence._connect with a mock that raises if called: it proves review_decision refuses a blank policy_version before opening any connection. It claims nothing about PostgreSQL; the database-backed replay, policy-version and separation-of-duties cases run against a real database in the wx10_6/wx10_7/wx10_10 and migration_033 live tests.

Wave 5 single-operator self-approval policy. The only stand-in patches persistence._connect with a mock that raises if called: it proves review_decision refuses a client-supplied reason that imitates the self-approval audit marker before opening any connection. It claims nothing about PostgreSQL; the database-backed self-approval and separation-of-duties path runs against a real database in test_wx10_7_decision_review.py.

Decision-service FORCE RLS on the remaining tenant tables (migration 037). The recording stand-in pins call order only: each fixed persistence function opens a transaction and runs set_config('app.current_tenant'|'app.current_worker', ..., true) before its first statement, because a transaction-local setting outside a transaction does not reach the query. It claims nothing about what PostgreSQL enforces; the policies, the fail-closed worker authorization, the tenant-only writes and the reads returning only the bound tenant's rows are proven against a real PG16 as a non-superuser NOBYPASSRLS owner in services/decision-service/tests/test_migration_037_force_rls_pg16.py (decision-033-pg16-proof job).

Satellite-field continuation port. The stand-in (SimpleNamespace conn with execute/fetchval/transaction and a patched get_pool) pins two hand-offs only: create_field passes the committed geometry_revision to trigger_field_imagery_processing, and the legacy-receipt path recovers a revision only when the current geometry for the same tenant matches. It claims nothing about what PostgreSQL enforces. The overlap guard, the per-tenant advisory lock, self-exclusion on edit and tenant scoping run against a real PostGIS in services/sahool-platform/tests/test_field_overlap_postgis.py (SAHOOL_FIELD_POSTGIS_TEST_URL), and the end-to-end revision rejection (raster answers 409 stale_geometry_revision to the delayed create-time task) was measured live as sahool_app under RLS before this PR.

Explicit one-file admission for the MFA enrollment and refresh HTTP regression suite. FakeConnection and FakePool supply selected user-row fields and record or simulate conditional SQL outcomes so the actual imported FastAPI application, bearer dependencies, HS256/RS256 verification, bcrypt, Fernet and TOTP can be exercised without PostgreSQL. The account-change race cases mutate synthetic rows before the modeled UPDATE and assert handler refusal; they do not prove PostgreSQL transaction isolation, row locking, RLS, trigger/constraint enforcement or concurrent database behavior. Redis is also a boundary double in this file, so GETDEL and TTL/distributed guarantees are not certified by its green result. These tests pin application control flow and authorization scope; live database and Redis enforcement remain unmeasured here. No proven_live exemption, budget increase or database-enforcement claim is added.

Admin authorization follow-up (#1427). The stand-in (FakeConnection with fetchrow only) drives _validate_team_actor through its decision table: an active owner/admin whose DB role matches the signed claim is admitted, while a missing, inactive or stale membership and a malformed tenant/subject are refused with 403. It asserts that the lookup carries the tenant predicate, but claims nothing about what PostgreSQL enforces. Tenant scoping of list/role/deactivate, the cross-tenant 404 indistinguishable from a missing user, peer owner/admin protection and the grant limits run against a real database under a NOBYPASSRLS role in tests_v9/test_auth_admin_tenant_scope_live_pg.py (15 passed on the merge of #1427 with main 153526f90).

Field geometry atomicity (#1447). The stand-in (_Conn with fetchval only) pins the contract the three geometry handlers rely on from save_field_geometry_revision: one INSERT into field_geometry_history on the caller's connection, the revision returned as an int, and an INSERT error propagated to the caller instead of being turned into None. It exists so the changed lines are measured by platform-unit-tests coverage; it claims nothing about what PostgreSQL enforces. The database behaviour (a refused history INSERT under REVOKE or a restrictive RLS policy aborts the transaction, the handler answers 5xx and the boundary, geometry_version and history stay unchanged) runs against a migrated database under a NOBYPASSRLS role in tests_v9/test_field_geometry_save_atomic_live_pg.py (4 passed; 3 fail on main). No proven_live exemption or database-enforcement claim is added.

Unified-timeline tenant scope (#1448). The stand-in (_Conn with fetch only, patched tenant_connection and _assert_field_in_tenant) pins the facade's two error branches so platform-unit-tests coverage measures them: the HTTPException raised by the tenant check propagates as a 404 instead of being folded into 200 degraded, and any other read failure answers degraded with a fixed message that does not echo the database error. Both cases fail on main. It claims nothing about what PostgreSQL enforces. The tenant refusal itself runs against a migrated database under a NOBYPASSRLS role in tests_v9/test_field_timeline_tenant_scope_live_pg.py (another tenant's field is 404; the caller's own field reads the events table with degraded false). No proven_live exemption or database-enforcement claim is added.
